principle: A permanent facility exists only because a sustained operational, social, economic, scientific or strategic need justifies its construction and continued support. The generator may not place stations as generic points of interest.
anti_gas_station_rule: NEVER generate a permanent station merely because a route, system, planet or player location lacks one nearby.

required_gates.rule: There must be at least one authoritative unmet need with identifiable beneficiaries/stakeholders.
The need must last long enough that fixed infrastructure is more rational than temporary/mobile support.
required_gates.failure_result: Use ships, tenders, mobile support units, temporary depots or mission-specific assets instead.

required_gates.rule: Evaluate cheaper/lighter alternatives before fixed construction.
required_gates.hard_rule: If a lower-cost alternative satisfies the need with acceptable risk/capacity, do not build a permanent station.

required_gates.rule: Check whether an existing reachable facility already provides sufficient service capacity.
required_gates.hard_rule: Do not create duplicate support stations just to reduce travel inconvenience unless demand, resilience or strategy explicitly justifies redundancy.

required_gates.rule: The scale of the facility must be justified by sustained traffic/population/service throughput or exceptional strategic/scientific value.
The sponsoring polity/organization must possess the technology, materials, personnel, industrial access and political authority to build and operate the facility.
The chosen location must support the intended function better than realistic alternatives after hazards, orbital mechanics, security, logistics and access are considered.
The facility must have a credible continuing supply/staff/maintenance chain. Construction without a sustainment model is forbidden.
Permanent facilities require planning, construction/refit time and resource commitment. They do not appear fully operational in one simulation tick.

lifecycle_rule: Need may justify planning first, then construction, commissioning, operation, expansion/contraction, mothballing or decommissioning. Facility existence is historical state, not a static map decoration.
persistence_rule: Once construction begins, the facility receives a stable facility_id. Cancellation, incomplete construction, abandonment, capture, refit and decommissioning preserve identity/history.
ai_boundary: AI cannot create a station to solve a narrative convenience.
AI cannot upgrade station scale because the player is important.
AI can propose construction only from authoritative need/capacity state.
